browserMethod: Normal speed, normal UI, isolated temporary in-memory stores, normal random rewards and both helpers. Final opening observations stop around 8 minutes; alive at the observation endpoint is not a 20-minute victory. Running tabs are not hot patched.
choiceCaptureLimit: The per-instance browser upgrade hook was replaced at run start. Empty choices do not mean no upgrades; inventory checkpoints and independent relic awards provide the observations. No precise choice times are claimed.
simulationLimit: Deterministic actual-engine regression, not browser play or a player win-rate estimate. The same initial seed does not guarantee identical later rewards after gameplay changes consume RNG differently.
incomingLimit: Browser incoming samples are capped at 1500 and aggregated here only over the retained samples; full raw files remain local. Engine incoming totals cover their full runs.
